en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Students will acquire the ability to orientate themselves in the basics of hydrostatics and hydrodynamics. They will acquire information about the basic characteristics of liquids, about phenomena originating during the flow of water in pressure systems and in open channels.
